cases.title: Follow public works through execution
cases.lesson: Show how drainage and road reinstatement can be coordinated, with dated officer remarks and an execution deadline.
cases.original_text: Chennai மாவட்டம், வார்டு 8. எங்கள் பகுதியில் சுமார் 59 குடும்பங்கள் இந்த வசதியை நம்பியுள்ளன. எங்கள் தெருவில் மூடிய வடிகாலும் முறையான குப்பை சேகரிப்பும் இல்லை. அடுத்த மழைக்காலத்திற்கு முன் வடிகாலும் பிரித்த குப்பை சேகரிக்கும் இடமும் அமைக்க வேண்டும். கள ஆய்வு செய்து நடவடிக்கை எடுக்குமாறு கேட்டுக்கொள்கிறோம்.
cases.translated_text: Ward 8, Chennai district. About 59 households depend on this service. There is no covered drain or regular waste collection on our street. Please plan drainage and a segregated waste collection point before the next rainy season. Please inspect the site and arrange action.

cases.title: Many voices, one water project
cases.lesson: Aggregate recurring water requests, examine deprivation and water coverage, then propose storage, source protection and distribution as one project.
cases.original_text: வார்டு 12, Karur மாவட்டத்திலிருந்து தெரிவிக்கிறோம். இங்கு 201 குடும்பங்கள் வசிக்கின்றன. மூன்று நாட்களாக குடிநீர் குழாயில் தண்ணீர் வரவில்லை. குடும்பங்கள் தண்ணீரை விலைக்கு வாங்குகின்றன. தற்காலிக குடிநீர் வழங்கி பழுதான பம்பை சரிசெய்யுங்கள். எங்கள் கோரிக்கையின் நிலையை தெரிவிக்கவும்.
cases.translated_text: We are writing from Ward 12 in Karur district, where 201 households live. The drinking-water line has been dry for three days. Families are buying water. Please arrange temporary supply and repair the failed pump. Please keep us informed about this request.

cases.title: Rural need beyond the loudest hotspot
cases.lesson: Compare lower report volumes with deprivation, access gaps and the population served. Explain why volume alone should not decide funding.
cases.original_text: వార్డు 4, Alluri Sitharama Raju జిల్లా నుంచి తెలియజేస్తున్నాం. ఇక్కడ 386 కుటుంబాలు నివసిస్తున్నాయి. ఆరోగ్య ఉపకేంద్రంలో నమ్మకమైన విద్యుత్ బ్యాకప్, టీకాల శీతల నిల్వ లేవు. గర్భిణుల పరీక్షలు, టీకాలు క్రమంగా జరిగేలా భవనం, పరికరాలను మెరుగుపరచండి. ఈ సమస్యకు శాశ్వత పరిష్కారం కావాలి.
cases.translated_text: We are writing from Ward 4 in Alluri Sitharama Raju district, where 386 households live. The health sub-centre has no reliable power backup or vaccine cold storage. Please upgrade the building and equipment so antenatal visits and immunisation can run regularly. We need a lasting solution to this problem.

cases.title: Start with an incoming citizen request
cases.lesson: Show the original Telugu text, its English translation and a consistent ticket ID before moving the request through officer review.
cases.original_text: వార్డు 6, Tirupati జిల్లా నుంచి తెలియజేస్తున్నాం. ఇక్కడ 157 కుటుంబాలు నివసిస్తున్నాయి. మా నివాస ప్రాంతానికి అందరికీ అనుకూలమైన కప్పుతో కూడిన బస్సు నిలయం, మార్కెట్‌కు ఆరోగ్య కేంద్రానికి క్రమమైన బస్సు అవసరం. నిలయాన్ని, సేవను కలిపి ప్రణాళిక చేయండి. స్థలాన్ని పరిశీలించి చర్య తీసుకోవాలని కోరుతున్నాం.
cases.translated_text: We are writing from Ward 6 in Tirupati district, where 157 households live. Our settlement needs a covered, accessible bus stop and a regular route to the market and health centre. Please plan the stop and service together. Please inspect the site and arrange action.

cases.title: Separate immediate safety from capital planning
cases.lesson: Escalate an immediate electrical hazard. Restore safety first; assess resilient feeder upgrades as a separate longer-term response.
cases.original_text: Visakhapatnam జిల్లా, వార్డు 9. మా ప్రాంతంలో సుమారు 184 కుటుంబాలు ఈ సదుపాయంపై ఆధారపడ్డాయి. బస్సు నిలయం దగ్గర నిలిచిన నీటిలో విద్యుత్ తీగ తెగిపడింది. ప్రజలు దాని పక్కనే నడుస్తున్నారు. వెంటనే విద్యుత్ నిలిపి ప్రాంతాన్ని సురక్షితం చేయండి. ఈ సమస్యకు శాశ్వత పరిష్కారం కావాలి.
cases.translated_text: Ward 9, Visakhapatnam district. About 184 households depend on this service. A live electricity wire has fallen into standing water near the bus stop. People are still walking past it. Please disconnect the supply and secure the area immediately. We need a lasting solution to this problem.

cases.lesson: Use the synthetic before/after cohort to explain impact monitoring. A decline is a demo signal; causal attribution also needs comparable controls and verified field evidence.
